name: LightShow Web Stream — Self-Hosted Audio
author: LightShow Web Stream contributors
description: Free, self-hosted music streaming synchronized approximately to FPP playback; optional developer contributions.

privacy.summary: Uploads show music, the media filename, timing and device ID to the HTTPS server configured by the show operator; the listener page optionally offers a Stripe-hosted contribution to the software developer.

sends.to: the backend HTTPS server you configure
sends.what: music files, show playback position, and player device ID
sends.why: to stream show audio to visitors

systemChanges.what: Installs a systemd service under the fpp account to poll FPP status and upload audio.

privacy.other: Audio is publicly accessible to anyone with the visitor URL. Optional listener donations go to the software developer, not the display owner. Stripe is contacted only when a listener opens the support panel. The show operator may disable donations. Only stream media for which you have rights.
